name: Eldrazi
description: The Eldrazi are an ancient species native to the Blind Eternities, with no physical form or color alignment, whose ceaseless hunger drives them to devour planes.

description_citations.text: "Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

summary.text: The Eldrazi are an ancient species native to the Blind Eternities, with no physical form or color alignment, whose ceaseless hunger drives them to devour planes.

citations.text: "Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Sorin Markov, Ugin and Nahiri decided to rid the Multiverse of the Eldrazi, but Ugin helped imprison them on Zendikar instead.

citations.text: "Eldrazi", section "Three against three". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Sorin lured the Eldrazi, Ugin bound them with colorless magic, and Nahiri built the hedron network that formed their prison.

citations.text: "Zendikar". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: A little over a thousand years before the great reawakening, the Eldrazi nearly escaped and Nahiri restored their prison alone.

citations.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

bio.text: Jace, Chandra and Sarkhan loosened the bonds in the Eye of Ugin chamber without meaning to, and Nissa then released the Eldrazi, thinking they would leave Zendikar behind.

citations.text: "Battle for Zendikar", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Battle for Zendikar", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: The freed titans summoned spawn and consumed two of Zendikar's seven continents, and within two years Sea Gate, Sejiri and Bala Ged were overrun.

citations.text: "Zendikar". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Zendikar (plane)", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Gideon gathered Drana, Noyan Dar, Tazri, Nissa and Kiora's forces and retook Sea Gate, and later held back the brood lineages while Chandra incinerated the bound titans.

citations.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.
Fall of the Titans (Oath of the Gatewatch, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Later stories mention the Eldrazi among the beings Jace's Echoverse is designed to be without, and as the monstrous race to which Emrakul belongs.

citations.text: "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

status.text: The Eldrazi titans of Zendikar were defeated in the Battle for Zendikar, and the latest stories only mention the Eldrazi as past threats, as beings the Drix hunt, or as absent from the Echoverse.

citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2026.

citations.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citations.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.
"Red Route" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nissa breaks the central hedron in the Eye of Ugin, freeing the Eldrazi Titans.
timeline.quote: Nissa breaking the central hedron in the Eye of Ugin

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ayli says gods do not die, they merely slumber, beside the Eldrazi monument.
timeline.quote: Gods don't die. They merely slumber.

citation.text: Eldrazi Monument (Zendikar, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: During the Eldrazi's return, kor gather around Glasspool and carve dwellings in the surrounding peaks.
timeline.quote: During the eldrazi's return, kor gathered in the area around Glasspool

citation.text: "Akoum", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zendikar's angels try to resist the first stirring of the Eldrazi but are defeated and wear their halos over their eyes.
timeline.quote: The angels were among the first creatures that attempted to mount a resistance against the first stirring of the Eldrazi but were easily defeated.

citation.text: "Angel", section "Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When the Eldrazi titans are released again, the halos of oppression shatter and the angels fight and mostly die.
timeline.quote: The angels fought, and mostly, they died.

citation.text: "Angel", section "Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zendikari elementals rise as pieces of the plane acting as antibodies against the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: Several elementals rose as pieces of the plane itself, acting as antibodies to the Eldrazi .

citation.text: "Elemental", section "Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Most of the Mul Daya are wiped out by the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: most of the Mul Daya were wiped out by the Eldrazi

citation.text: "Elf", section "Mul Daya Nation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The ancient kor empire of Zendikar falls one by one to rebellions, civil wars and the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: One by one they fell to rebellions, civil wars, and eventually the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Kor", section "Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aida Lunda plans to journey into the heart of the Singing City, hoping to learn the Eldrazi message.
timeline.quote: I can feel a breakthrough coming.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Zendikar: Murasa and Sejiri
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Zendikar: Murasa and Sejiri". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Feb 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Thousands of years ago three Eldrazi descend on Zendikar and spawn brood lineages to pillage it.
timeline.quote: Thousands of years ago, three Eldrazi monstrosities descended on Zendikar

citation.text: "Gods and Monsters". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ugin, a lithomancer and Sorin Markov trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar with a lock-spell at the Eye of Ugin and leave.
timeline.quote: the planeswalkers trapped the Eldrazi on Zendikar

citation.text: "Gods and Monsters". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Zendikar survives and slowly recovers as the brood lineages die off and the colossi fall inert.
timeline.quote: The brood lineages died off and the Eldrazi colossi fell inert

citation.text: "Gods and Monsters". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: An Eldrazi rises from the cracked orb and is defeated, revealing the hedron runes describe an Eldrazi prison.
timeline.quote: You defeat the horrendous Eldrazi creature, saving the continent of Tazeem from its destruction.

citation.text: "Booster Quest: The Shaman's Orb". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi are lured to Zendikar and lulled into torpor by the hedron prison; centuries later they rise again and obliterate the land and the living.
timeline.quote: But when the abominations rose again several centuries later, Zendikar was unprepared for their assault

citation.text: "The Defiance of Angels". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Angels try to resist the Eldrazi but their resistance is cut through.
timeline.quote: Archangels drew their swords and stood between the Eldrazi and the land of Zendikar

citation.text: "The Defiance of Angels". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi leave halos on the angels worn down over their eyes, blinding them and keeping them from interfering.
timeline.quote: Each angel's halo is worn down over her eyes, symbolizing her mystical blindness to the Eldrazi's atrocities

citation.text: "The Defiance of Angels". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Iona and a few greater archangels keep their sight and fight the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: To this day Iona fights to defend Zendikar from the Eldrazi forces that would devour it

citation.text: "The Defiance of Angels". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi titans are lured out of the aether and bound to Zendikar for thousands of years.
timeline.quote: luring the Eldrazi titans out of the aether and binding them to a world for thousands of years

citation.text: "Rise of the Inbox". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Eldrazi materialize on Zendikar and their brood lineages spring up around the three titans.
timeline.quote: Even when they materialized into Zendikar, their bizarre forms still had no particular resonance with any of the five colors

citation.text: "Rise of the Inbox". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The hedrons coalesce into colossal Eldrazi superstructures, forcing the griffins to seek new territory.
timeline.quote: As the hedrons began to coalesce into colossal Eldrazi superstructures

citation.text: Makindi Griffin (Rise of the Eldrazi, 2010), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi travel from plane to plane, draining the color and energy from the lands they devour and leaving Wastes behind.
timeline.quote: This sapping of energy drains its magical color and leaves behind Wastes

citation.text: "Colorless", section "Flavor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov, Ugin and Nahiri decide to rid the Multiverse of the Eldrazi; Ugin helps imprison them on Zendikar instead.
timeline.quote: Ugin told them that it wouldn't be a good idea to destroy them and instead helped them imprison the Eldrazi on the plane of Zendikar.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Three against three". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin, Nahiri and Ugin ally against the Eldrazi but cannot defeat them, and instead imprison them on Zendikar with a hedron network centered on the Eye of Ugin.
timeline.quote: Instead of killing the Eldrazi, they caused the Imprisonment of the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vampires build a shrine near the Eye, destabilizing the prison; Nahiri awakens, calls for help in vain, restores the prison alone, then leaves to find Sorin.
timeline.quote: She succeeded on her own, and restored the prison.

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "First breaking". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin returns, frees Anowon and goes with Nissa to the Eye, where Nissa shatters the main hedron, releasing the Eldrazi; Sorin leaves the plane.
timeline.quote: she shattered the main Hedron and released the enchantment imprisoning the titans

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "Release of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Three plan to trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar; Sorin lures them, Ugin binds them and Nahiri builds the hedron prison.
timeline.quote: Nahiri constructed a massive network of stone hedrons

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "The Three against the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vampires build a shrine at the hedron nexus, destabilizing the prison; Nahiri wakes, calls unanswered for help and restores it alone.
timeline.quote: She succeeded on her own in restoring the prison.

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Guarding Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi brood attacks the Tajuru meeting and kills Sutina.
timeline.quote: the Eldrazi brood attacked the meeting and killed Sutina shortly after it began

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Rise of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Eye of Ugin, Nissa shatters the main hedron and releases the Eldrazi titans.
timeline.quote: she shattered the main hedron and released the enchantment imprisoning the titans

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Rise of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sea Gate and the Enclave fall to the Eldrazi spawn and Noyan Dar leads refugees upriver to found Coralhelm Refuge.
timeline.quote: he led refugees from the Enclave farther upriver to found Coralhelm Refuge

citation.text: "Noyan Dar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi, long imprisoned on Zendikar, are released, making the plane's perils deadlier.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi have been released.

citation.text: "Rise of the Eldrazi", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin allies with Nahiri and Ugin to imprison the Eldrazi on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: the three planeswalkers imprisoned them

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Within two years of the Eldrazi's release, Sea Gate is overrun and destroyed, Oran-Rief dies and Halimar is emptied.
timeline.quote: Within two years of the release of the Eldrazi, Sea Gate was overrun and destroyed.

citation.text: "Tazeem", section "Rise of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ugin, Sorin and Nahiri lure and imprison the Eldrazi on Zendikar for 6,000 years.
timeline.quote: The Imprisonment of the Eldrazi caused the three Titans to become trapped in the plane for 6,000 years.

citation.text: "Ugin", section "The Three". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cultists of Akoum loosen the Eldrazi prison and broods devastate Zendikar.
timeline.quote: their rituals proved effective in loosening the bonds of the Eldrazi prison.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "First awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Three decide to trap the Eldrazi on a plane and choose Nahiri's Zendikar for its lush ecosystems and dynamic mana.
timeline.quote: They decided on Nahiri's own Zendikar .

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin lures the Eldrazi, Ugin binds them with colorless magic, and Nahiri builds the hedron network that forms their prison.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov lured the Eldrazi to the plane

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri repairs the hedron network, slays Zhulodok and returns the Eldrazi to slumber.
timeline.quote: Nahiri slew Zhulodok and sealed the Eldrazi in their hedronic prison again

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The first awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eldrazi attack Turntimber, killing Speaker Sutina and Hiba and destroying the village Mosscrack.
timeline.quote: However, Eldrazi attack, killing Speaker Sutina and Nissa's friend Hiba , and destroying Mosscrack, a village in the Tajuru home tree.

citation.work: Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum
citation.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At sea Sorin reveals he is a planeswalker and that the Eldrazi titans are bound beneath Akoum, and it is his duty to keep them sealed.
timeline.quote: Sorin finally reveals the truth of their mission and admits he, too, is a planeswalker.

citation.work: Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum
citation.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The party is captured by the keepers of Ora Ondor, but the brood besiege the settlement and the group escapes as Ora Ondor falls.
timeline.quote: As they flee, Ora Ondor is overtaken by Eldrazi.

citation.work: Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum
citation.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The three legendary Eldrazi trapped on Zendikar rise again, each spawning a brood lineage of minions.
timeline.quote: have risen again.

citation.text: "The Three Brood Lineages". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Answering a reader, the author reasons that the Eldrazi, outside their physical forms, would be incomprehensibly powerful in the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: I think the Eldrazi's Ætheric nature, like the Blind Eternities themselves, would be incomprehensible to the point of madness.

citation.text: "Form of the Writer". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The author guesses that the Mending did little to the Eldrazi, who have no sparks and are native to the spaces between worlds.
timeline.quote: They don't have planeswalker sparks, and they don't planeswalk from world to world the way planeswalkers do.

citation.text: "Form of the Writer". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The old master tells his students that the reason for their training is now clear: the Eldrazi threat has come, and they must wage war against them.
timeline.quote: Now you wage war against the Eldrazi, and show them what beings of this world are capable of.

citation.text: "Rising to the Occasion". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi arrive on Zendikar, killing people where they stand and leaving no safe pockets of civilization.
timeline.quote: Instead of simply failing to return from dangerous safaris in exotic wildernesses, people are being snuffed where they stand.

citation.text: "Rising to the Occasion". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Adventurers abandon treasure hunting and prepare to fight the Eldrazi, with the levelers rising to stand against them.
timeline.quote: Rise of the Eldrazi 's "levelers" are adventurers who've taken it upon themselves to stand up against the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Rising to the Occasion". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: With the Eldrazi already eating the gates, someone pumps Zendikar's heroes full of mana to rush their growth.
timeline.quote: So someone—perhaps a handful of ancient teacher-types, perhaps planeswalkers, perhaps Zendikar itself—is pumping the world's heroes full of mana to rush the process.

citation.text: "Rising to the Occasion". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Flashback: thousands of years ago the Eldrazi first awoke from torpor and nearly destroyed the natural world while humanoids did not slow them.
timeline.quote: Thousands of years ago when the Eldrazi first awoke from their torpor, the destruction was vast; the natural world nearly perished at the touch of a tentacle.

citation.text: "Rising to the Occasion". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The native peoples of Zendikar, the Kor, merfolk and vampires, try to understand the Eldrazi and how to defeat them.
timeline.quote: The Kor, merfolk, and vampires all tried to understand and figure out what the Eldrazi were and how could they defeat them.

citation.text: "First Week's Flavor". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jun 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi arise once more on Zendikar, and the merfolk realize they had mistaken the Eldrazi names for the legends of gods.
timeline.quote: But as the Eldrazi arose once more, the merfolk came to understand their mistake.

citation.text: "Auratouched Magery". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The columnist explains that Zendikari are unlikely to have understood any Eldrazi communication, so the Eldrazi did not introduce themselves.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi consciousness is too alien, too starkly different for our forms of language to latch on to their forms of awareness.

citation.text: "Auratouched Magery". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Kiora, unable to return to Zendikar without a weapon against the Eldrazi, continues her search and planeswalks through the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: Not without a weapon to fight the monstrosities called the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Kiora's Followers" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Kruphix reveals his fear: threats from the Eldrazi, an ancient dragon planeswalker and Phyrexia could destroy Theros while even the gods are powerless.
timeline.quote: even the gods may be powerless to stop them.

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Nissa wakes pinned under a fallen tree after the Eldrazi swarm and Ulamog's return devastate her Joraga tribe.
timeline.quote: Eldrazi had swarmed the Joraga. There had been a great blast of energy. Ulamog had returned.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Hamadi tells Nissa how his people of Graypelt were destroyed by the Eldrazi, and Nissa, overcome by guilt, apologizes.
timeline.quote: She was responsible for all of it, all his loss and all of Zendikar's devastation.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis says that heroes coming to fight the Eldrazi will need what he knows about the hedrons, and that he feels his spark within reach after Bala Ged's destruction.
timeline.quote: My spark is within reach.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Sorin worries over Nahiri's silence and Ugin's absence while the Eldrazi titans rampage on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi titans were a fire that could not be quenched, and Ugin's absence was strange.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sorin fears Zendikar and then Innistrad will be consumed and says they are all doomed.
timeline.quote: We're all doomed,

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: An enormous Eldrazi rises beyond the valley and the brood surges toward the camp.
timeline.quote: Then a figure, impossibly large, rose up behind the hills on the far side of the valley.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, Sorin and Lian fight the first wave of Eldrazi brood at the wall, but the titan's pull drains their magic.
timeline.quote: Nahiri could feel her mana spiraling away even as she gathered it.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin reveals he watched the destruction without helping, in order to learn about the Eldrazi, and explains what they are and why they cannot simply be killed.
timeline.quote: They're called the Eldrazi," said Ugin, "and they devour entire worlds.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin proposes imprisoning the three true Eldrazi on a single plane, binding them with physical anchors and forcing them into dormancy.
timeline.quote: Bind them to one plane using their physical forms as anchors, and force them into dormancy.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri warns Zendikar's peoples of the coming Eldrazi as the titans slowly approach the hedron-lit plane.
timeline.quote: Nahiri spread word throughout the plane of what was coming

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin traps the Eldrazi on Zendikar, learning little from Sorin but the rudiments of lithomancy from Nahiri.
timeline.quote: While trapping the Eldrazi on Zendikar, Ugin learned little from Sorin

citation.text: Ugin's Construct (Ugin's Fate, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Ugin that over a thousand years have passed and the Eldrazi have escaped their hedron prison on Zendikar, partly through Nissa's choice.
timeline.quote: They're free." Sorin had the urge to press the matter, to needle Ugin, to make someone else shoulder the blame.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan names Bolas as the one who sent him to the Eye to release the Eldrazi, and Ugin contains him briefly in a sphere of force before releasing him.
timeline.quote: He wanted it opened, the devourers released. He never told me why.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Six thousand years earlier, Nahiri and Sorin fail to save an unknown plane from the Eldrazi, then agree with Ugin to imprison the titans on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The trap is sprung, the titans are subdued, and Nahiri settles in for a long vigil to keep them imprisoned.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi stir and Nahiri wakes from her long slumber, a thousand years before the great reawakening.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi stirred. Nahiri woke.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Zendikar breaks open; Nahiri senses the Eldrazi prison has been opened.
timeline.quote: the prison of the Eldrazi. It was open.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri crushes Eldrazi with an avalanche, then enters a ruined kor city in Ondu and remembers her old life.
timeline.quote: sent an avalanche to crush the abominations

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri visits the hedron network's sites, burying the Eldrazi broods she finds, and determines she must stop them alone.
timeline.quote: But she was alone, and she would do it alone.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri reshapes the statue into a new hedron, holding off more vampires and Eldrazi while she works alone.
timeline.quote: and brought the walls down on them, then returned to her work.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri completes the hedron and repairs the Eldrazi prison, driving the titans back into torpor.
timeline.quote: to link up the broken lines of the hedron network and repair the Eldrazi prison.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon kills an Eldrazi monstrosity on Zendikar with a shard of hedron after a hard fight.
timeline.quote: Hedron connected with boney faceplate.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon holds a canyon pass against Eldrazi spawn while survivors from Bala Ged escape.
timeline.quote: Gideon planted himself in the narrow path

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: A mage collapses the cliffs with lightning along Munda's iron spikes, burying the Eldrazi spawn.
timeline.quote: sheets of white stone tumbled toward the Eldrazi below.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Munda tells Gideon a great host of Eldrazi descends on Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: "A great host of Eldrazi descends on Sea Gate."

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi overwhelm Sea Gate and pin Gideon under a beam until he frees himself.
timeline.quote: the Eldrazi swept in from both sides of the sea wall.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon rides an Eldrazi off the sea wall into the sea, then planeswalks to Ravnica.
timeline.quote: In a tangle of tendrils, Gideon fell with it.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace admits to himself he inadvertently released the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: Inadvertently released them from millennia of imprisonment to terrorize Zendikar

citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya hear screams and see Eldrazi attacking a small encampment.
timeline.quote: "There!" Nissa pointed.

citation.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya crush the first Eldrazi, fight the tentacled one and cripple it, but the third carries off the kor, who is consumed.
timeline.quote: the Eldrazi consumed the kor's life, turning her still, pale body into dust.

citation.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya kill the one-tentacled Eldrazi with a spear of land and a punch from Ashaya.
timeline.quote: The horror let out a final deflating chitter as it collapsed.

citation.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jace arrive at Vorik's camp and find slaughter and Eldrazi corruption everywhere.
timeline.quote: They stepped into carnage.

citation.text: "Slaughter at the Refuge" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon defends Jace from a pack of Eldrazi spawn and arms him with a sword.
timeline.quote: Gideon leaped between the Eldrazi and Jace.

citation.text: "Slaughter at the Refuge" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon charges through hundreds of Eldrazi to reach a barricade of survivors and gets Jace over the wall.
timeline.quote: Gideon bellowed, "Zendikar!" and charged.

citation.text: "Slaughter at the Refuge" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace's telekinesis saves him from Eldrazi spawn.
timeline.quote: knocked back by what must have been a telekinetic blow.

citation.text: "Slaughter at the Refuge" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon kills a huge Ulamog-like Eldrazi with two heads by punching the smaller head and severing both.
timeline.quote: the Eldrazi fell dead to the ground.

citation.text: "Slaughter at the Refuge" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon collapses the walls of a gap to block the Eldrazi and rejoins the survivors.
timeline.quote: he had created a defensive wall.

citation.text: "Slaughter at the Refuge" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Ashaya relays a distress call from Fartree Hamlet, and Nissa and Ashaya rush to help, finding three Eldrazi instead of two.
timeline.quote: But the chatter was wrong; there were three Eldrazi, not two.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa chooses to attack the twin Eldrazi at the hamlet first, planning to reach the heart trees after.
timeline.quote: "We have to give the most help we can give,"

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya rescue the humans from the treehouses by bending a tree and shielding them with a wall of land.
timeline.quote: Nissa pulled on the tree, urging it to bend to her.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya kill the first twin Eldrazi by snapping the tree into its faceplate and gutting it.
timeline.quote: Its limbs went limp, and then the monstrous thing teetered back and crashed to the forest floor.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa rips the second twin apart with root tentacles and saves the humans from its falling body.
timeline.quote: carried the people back and away as the Eldrazi struck the ground.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya arrive too late at the thicket, where the Eldrazi has killed all but two heart trees, and then kill it.
timeline.quote: The monster was both killed and buried in the same stroke.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: A wounded merfolk saves Nissa from walking into an Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: It was a merfolk, one clad in thick, sharp armor made of seashells.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa carries Jori En and fights with her sword, but without Zendikar's help she is pinned by an Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: She pulled on her arm with her all, but the tentacle was too heavy.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: A huge Eldrazi lands on the rock and Gideon appears, lashing it away with his sural and hauling everyone up.
timeline.quote: four glowing, white whips fly through the air and lash into the Eldrazi's side.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Eldrazi spawn attack Jace and Jori's coach, and the hurda panics.
timeline.quote: When the swarm of Eldrazi spawn crested the hill

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Seble flies Gideon to intercept a flying Eldrazi pursuing a party of refugees, and Gideon kills it after being thrown from the manta.
timeline.quote: he drove the Eldrazi straight into the ground

citation.text: "The Survivors of Sky Rock" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Drana releases the Eldrazi energy as a magenta sun that heals her army and destroys the Eldrazi, then collapses.
timeline.quote: I belong to no one . . . but they belong to me.

citation.text: "Memories of Blood" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: A fleeing goblin warns Nissa of a swarm of Eldrazi, and Nissa fights them with only her sword to protect the clearing.
timeline.quote: She stepped forward to stand between the precious piece of land and the monsters.

citation.text: "Nissa's Quest" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa nearly planeswalks away from the swarm but refuses because it would mean it was over.
timeline.quote: But leaving would mean that it was over.

citation.text: "Nissa's Quest" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Munda arrives and helps kill the swarm, and Nissa joins him in tracking the goblin.
timeline.quote: a hook on a chain rushed past her and plunged into one of the Eldrazi

citation.text: "Nissa's Quest" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora finds a beach of grey Eldrazi dust and senses dead places across the sea.
timeline.quote: Eldrazi in the oceans!

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora uses the bident and sea creatures to drive Eldrazi off a hundred merfolk refugees.
timeline.quote: A vortex formed near one of the Eldrazi, sending it tumbling.

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Eldrazi of Ulamog's lineage ravage the continent of Bala Ged.
timeline.quote: The continent of Bala Ged was ravaged by massive Eldrazi of Ulamog's lineage

citation.text: Bane of Bala Ged (Battle for Zendikar, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kalitas returns to mindless servitude beneath the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: Kalitas may have returned to mindless servitude beneath the Eldrazi, but we say never again.

citation.text: Kalastria Nightwatch (Battle for Zendikar, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Goblins first see hedrons' potential against the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: Goblins were first to see the potential of hedrons in the fight against the Eldrazi

citation.text: Lavastep Raider (Battle for Zendikar, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Within two years of the release of the Eldrazi, Bala Ged is overrun and destroyed.
timeline.quote: the entire continent of Bala Ged was overrun and destroyed.

citation.text: "Bala Ged", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, Ugin and Sorin Markov use hedrons to trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Together with Ugin and Sorin Markov she used them to trap the horrendous Eldrazi on the plane.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thousands of years later, Sarkhan, Chandra and Jace meet in the Eye of Ugin chamber, unintentionally loosening the bonds on the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: unintentionally loosened the bonds that kept the Eldrazi in torpor.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa releases the Eldrazi, thinking they would leave Zendikar behind; she is wrong.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi were finally released by the elf Nissa Revane , thinking that they would leave Zendikar far behind them.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon takes the lead of a group of planeswalkers facing the Eldrazi, while Ob Nixilis seeks a way off the plane.
timeline.quote: Now, Gideon Jura takes the lead of a group of planeswalkers in facing the Eldrazi alongside the residents of Zendikar.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kiora arrives with merfolk and sea monster reinforcements for the Liberation of Sea Gate, meets Gideon, and they retake the city together.
timeline.quote: After 2 more days of fighting, they had retaken Sea Gate.

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa shatters the main hedron at the Eye of Ugin, releasing the Eldrazi, and Sorin washes his hands of her and Zendikar.
timeline.quote: she shattered the main Hedron and released the enchantment imprisoning the titans

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Return to Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Within two years Sea Gate, Sejiri and Bala Ged are overrun in the Battle for Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Sea Gate on Tazeem and the entire continents of Sejiri and Bala Ged were overrun

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa instinctively kills a gomazoa-like Eldrazi and realizes it must have fed on life, leading her toward Khalni Heart.
timeline.quote: She quartered the monstrosity so quickly

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Following the Eldrazi's trail to a surrakar cave, Nissa finds a moss-lined tunnel.
timeline.quote: she saw the first sign of life.

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi swarm toward Gideon and Noyan while the initiates spread in a wide circle.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi slowly began swarming in the direction of Gideon and Noyan

citation.text: "Shaping an Army" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: The initiates work the circle while Noyan gathers irritation into the Roil as Gideon holds the Eldrazi at bay.
timeline.quote: the large circle of earth surrounding Gideon and Noyan began to rotate in one direction and then the other.

citation.text: "Shaping an Army" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Noyan unleashes the Roil, collapsing the ground into a chasm that kills the Eldrazi horde and drops Gideon with it.
timeline.quote: Noyan cast his spell.

citation.text: "Shaping an Army" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon leads a headlong charge against Eldrazi spawn and larger Eldrazi near Sea Gate, while many soldiers die.
timeline.quote: The spawn fell quickly under the initial charge

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon orders a retreat, which turns into a rout as the army dissolves, leaving Gideon, Munda and a few soldiers to hold off the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: The ordered retreat turned into a rout.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: A scout reports a fleet of sea monsters swimming toward Sea Gate and leaving Eldrazi remains behind them, and Gideon takes them for allies.
timeline.quote: "Allies, then," Gideon said. "At least for now."

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: At dusk the army retreats in a planned maneuver and Drana's vampires take the front ranks, fighting through the night.
timeline.quote: But the maneuver went off without incident.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora summons a wave and her sea creatures tear into the Eldrazi, announcing the battle of Sea Gate has begun.
timeline.quote: The ocean churned as sharks and whales, serpents and krakens, tore into the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: In the streets of the city the army's elves, goblins, kitesailers and eel-riders each play their role against the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: That meant it was time to let other forces do what they did best.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Elementals of tree and stone march through Sea Gate crushing the Eldrazi, and Gideon sees that Nissa has returned bringing Zendikar with her.
timeline.quote: Nissa had returned. And she had indeed brought Zendikar with her.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: The tide turns, and the Zendikari drive the Eldrazi out of the city.
timeline.quote: And the Zendikari had the upper hand. They were going to win!

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Eldrazi minds are the only ones able to open hedrons.
timeline.quote: Only the Eldrazi mind thinks in the warped paths required to open the hedrons and tap the power within.

citation.text: Dreamstone Hedron (Commander 2015, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: At Sea Gate he sees Ulamog trapped in an enormous hedron network.
timeline.quote: Armies clashing, spawn and Zendikari slaughtered by the thousands, and rising above it all, Ulamog. Trapped.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: A scout on a manta nearly spots Chandra, who runs into three Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: she was face-to-faceplate with a trio of angular, meaty-ribbed, bony-headed creatures.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Chandra kills the three Eldrazi with fire.
timeline.quote: creating a tripartite blade of fire that sliced through each one of them.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin imprison the Eldrazi titans on Zendikar using a network of hedrons built by Nahiri.
timeline.quote: The Planeswalkers' trap worked.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: A little over a thousand years ago the Eldrazi nearly escape and Nahiri restores their prison alone, then goes to check on her absent allies and is not seen again.
timeline.quote: Nahiri restored the Eldrazi's prison on her own

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Sorin returns with Nissa to seal the Eye, but Nissa breaks the last bonds and the Eldrazi titans emerge.
timeline.quote: she broke the last bonds holding them in, and the titans emerged into the world.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon arrives on Zendikar, defends the Zendikari, faces a titan and leaves to seek reinforcements on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: Vowing to return, he left in search of aid at the center of Planeswalker activity: the city-world of Ravnica.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jace find Sea Gate overrun and hold off the Eldrazi so survivors can flee.
timeline.quote: the two were able to hold off the Eldrazi to allow survivors to flee to safety.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon gathers Drana, Noyan Dar, Tazri, Nissa and Kiora's forces and retakes Sea Gate from the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: Together, their combined forces managed to wrest Sea Gate away from the Eldrazi invaders.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Nissa carve a path through the Eldrazi swarm.
timeline.quote: Gideon and Nissa carved a path through the Eldrazi swarm, and their Zendikari allies charged into the fray behind them.

citation.text: Lead by Example (Oath of the Gatewatch, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gideon holds back the brood lineages while Chandra incinerates the bound titans.
timeline.quote: As Gideon kept the brood lineages at bay, Chandra incinerated the bound Eldrazi titans.

citation.text: Fall of the Titans (Oath of the Gatewatch, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Chandra lures hellions into the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: Chandra used jets of flame to lure hellions into the path of oncoming Eldrazi.

citation.text: Cinder Hellion (Oath of the Gatewatch, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Chandra searches the battlefield for Gideon and Jace while two titans wander the land and a swarm approaches.
timeline.quote: Too many to take on by herself.

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra lures the Eldrazi swarm away from Tazri's wounded in a cyclone of fire.
timeline.quote: A roaring cyclone made of churning flame whirled across the field ahead of her

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Chandra by telepathy to burn the Eldrazi drones, and she rallies and does so, freeing her friends.
timeline.quote: slamming into the Eldrazi drones that lurked near her friends.

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra and the others reunite as Nissa introduces herself, and the Eldrazi swarm Chandra lured arrives.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi swarm, the same horde that Chandra had lured away from Sea Gate, came skittering into the chamber

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon leads the planeswalkers out of the cavern and they scatter the Eldrazi swarm at the cave mouth.
timeline.quote: Gideon was the first to emerge from the cavern

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace and Kiora clear Eldrazi drones from the path of the bait army, with Kiora riding waves and sweeping them into a ravine.
timeline.quote: a wall of water swung around her like a sea god's punch

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: The titans distort, the sky becomes the titans, and it begins raining Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: And then it began raining Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace explains that Sorin helped trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar and that Jace and two other planeswalkers inadvertently freed them (recounted).
timeline.quote: Manipulated and coerced, two other Planeswalkers and I inadvertently released the Eldrazi titans from their prison.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Gisa and Geralf briefly team up against the Eldrazi that invaded Innistrad.
timeline.quote: Gisa and Geralf briefly managed to put their differences aside to team up against the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri says the Eldrazi broke free of their bonds and she resealed their prison alone.
timeline.quote: With all the strength I could muster, I managed to reseal the titans' prison.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri tells Sorin she resealed the Eldrazi prison alone after neither he nor Ugin answered her signal.
timeline.quote: With all the strength I could muster, I managed to reseal the titans' prison.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Recounted: Nahiri stood watch over the imprisoned Eldrazi for five thousand years, then fought them off alone when they escaped.
timeline.quote: For five thousand years, Nahiri stood watch over their monstrous prisoners.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri finds the Eye of Ugin collapsed and the three Eldrazi titans escaped.
timeline.quote: But the Eye was a ruin, collapsed in on itself.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The kor tell Nahiri of the titans' rise and that some believe they are their old gods.
timeline.quote: three enormous monstrosities rose out of the Teeth of Akoum.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Eldrazi of Ulamog's brood attack the Infinite Guideline Station around 4564 AR.
timeline.quote: Eldrazi of what appeared to be Ulamog's brood attacked the Infinite Guideline Station and its occupants around 4564 AR

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The Edge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A lone missionary marches a pilgrimage through outposts struck by the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: a tour of the Eldrazi-stricken outposts across Zendikar

citation.text: Lone Missionary (Modern Masters 2017, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Some vampires remind others of their loyalty after the awakening of the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: After the awakening of the Eldrazi, some vampires took it upon themselves to remind the others where their loyalty should lie.

citation.text: Inquisition of Kozilek (Modern Masters 2017, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Vampires fought the Eldrazi and many learned to live among humans.
timeline.quote: As they fought the Eldrazi, many vampires learned to live among humans.

citation.text: Vampire Nighthawk (Modern Masters 2017, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ugin tells Jace the hedrons can imprison the Eldrazi, and Jace questions how that worked last time.
timeline.quote: "You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."

citation.text: Hedron Archive (Commander 2017, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: As the Eldrazi spread, Zendikar's defenders seek any secret that could give them an advantage.
timeline.quote: As the Eldrazi spread, no secret that could give Zendikar's defenders an advantage was considered too dangerous to seek.

citation.text: Painful Truths (Commander 2017, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sorin, Ugin and Nahiri imprison the Eldrazi on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi are imprisoned on Zendikar by Sorin, Ugin , and Nahiri .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Time of Legends (-5000 AR to 0 AR) [ 17 ] [ 10 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ugin tells Jace the hedrons' purpose is that the Eldrazi can be imprisoned; Jace asks how that worked last time.
timeline.quote: "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."

citation.text: Hedron Archive (Commander 2018, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi nearly eliminate the Joraga.
timeline.quote: the Joraga were nearly eliminated
